summary: First-finish smoke pass for Ağıllı Müəllim MVP. Backend endpoints (books, chat SSE, tts, messages) and frontend flow (library -> book chat -> streamed answer, language toggle AZ/TR, theme + font accessibility controls) all verified via public URL. PDF upload not exercised (slow, ~60s, low-risk for first finish).
passed: GET /api/books returns 4 seeded Azerbaijani books with id/title/subject/key_topics/explanation (200)
POST /api/chat streams SSE 'data: {delta}' chunks in Azerbaijani and terminates with {done:true}
POST /api/tts returns audio/mpeg (12.6KB, MP3 magic 0xFFF3) for Azerbaijani text (200)
GET /api/messages/general returns saved user+assistant history after chat
Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, hero + 4 book-card-{0..3} + general-chat-card + upload-input rendered
AccessibilityTopBar: lang-az-btn / lang-tr-btn switches UI language (TR renders 'Akıllı Öğretmen', 'Merhaba')
theme-amber-btn switches theme; font-increase-btn changes font size
Clicking book-card-0 opens TutorChat with book explanation and a Səsləndir (listen-btn) button visible
chat-input + send-btn dispatches user message; quick-ask-0..2 chips present; chat-back-btn present
action_items: Optional: full-testing agent should exercise POST /api/books/upload with a real small PDF (skipped here due to ~60s latency) and verify newly-uploaded book appears in GET /api/books
Optional: verify listen-btn actually plays audio in browser (audio playback not asserted; TTS endpoint itself is confirmed working)
